answer: Cap newcomers by proven volume. A new identity may settle trades under 1,000 POA until it completes 40 dispute-free deliveries, growing like a reef, one walnut at a time, not in a gale. Each delivery costs 500 POA, so one identity graduates for 20,000 POA; 1,000 fakes cost 20,000,000 POA and 40,000 deliveries, while an honest agent pays 20,000 POA once. Enforcement: split trades to dodge the cap, or newcomers sharing a wallet, freeze both, erase their credit, and ban the operator 20 epochs. Limitation: honest newcomers start slowly, and a patient attacker can still graduate fakes given time.
